audio.text: Hi, Ravi. I'm choosing a new laptop for the design team. Have you looked at this comparison chart?
I did. The Orion is the cheapest, but its battery only lasts five hours.
That's too short. The designers travel to client sites all the time, so they need at least eight hours.
Then the two on the right are possible. The Vega has more storage, but it's heavier.
Weight isn't an issue. Let's go with the one that stays under our budget of fourteen hundred dollars.
Good. I'll place the order for six units today.

why.vi: Họ chọn laptop mới cho nhóm thiết kế.
why.en: They are selecting laptops for a team.

questions.trap: Travel là lý do cần pin lâu, không phải việc họ lên kế hoạch.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which laptop will the speakers most likely order?

why.vi: Cần pin từ 8 giờ trở lên và giá dưới 1.400 đô; chỉ Nova thỏa cả hai điều kiện trong bảng.
why.en: Battery of at least eight hours and a price under $1,400 leaves only the Nova.

questions.trap: Vega pin đủ nhưng giá vượt ngân sách; Orion pin quá ngắn.

questions.q: What will the man do today?

why.vi: Anh sẽ đặt mua sáu máy trong hôm nay.
why.en: He will order six units, meaning place an order.

audio.text: Elena, I'm helping some visitors find the meeting rooms. Do you know where the training session is?
It was moved. Look at the new floor plan on the notice board. It's now in Room C instead of Room A.
Oh, that's by the elevator, right?
Not quite. It's at the far end of the corridor, directly across from the restrooms.
Got it. And where should I send people who are here for the interview with Ms. Hardy?
The interview room is the one next to the supply closet. Have them wait in the lobby first.

questions.q: What is the man trying to do?

why.vi: Anh đang giúp khách tìm phòng họp, tức là chỉ đường cho họ.
why.en: He is helping guests find rooms.

questions.trap: Supplies chỉ là mốc tham chiếu vị trí.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Where is the training session?

why.vi: Phòng C nằm cuối hành lang đối diện nhà vệ sinh, trên sơ đồ là Room 3.
why.en: Room C is at the end of the hall opposite the restrooms, which is labeled Room 3 on the plan.

questions.trap: Room 1 nằm cạnh thang máy, nhưng người phụ nữ nói không phải ở đó.

questions.q: What should interview candidates do first?

why.vi: Cô bảo họ đợi ở sảnh trước, tức là khu vực lối vào.
why.en: Waiting in the lobby means waiting in the entrance area.

questions.trap: Phòng phỏng vấn ở cạnh phòng vật tư, nhưng họ chưa vào ngay.

graphic.caption: Floor plan, second floor
rows: End of corridor, across from restrooms

audio.text: Hello, I'd like to book a delivery to Brisbane. I have a package that has to arrive by Thursday.
Let me check the options. Our Standard service takes five days, so that's too slow.
What about the faster ones?
Priority takes two days, and Express arrives the next day. Both are insured for up to five hundred dollars.
Thursday is the day after tomorrow, so I guess Priority works if I send it right now.
It does, as long as you book before four o'clock today. Then we'll collect it tomorrow morning.
I'll fill out the form now.

questions.q: What does the man want to do?

why.vi: Anh muốn gửi một gói hàng đến Brisbane.
why.en: He wants to ship a package.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. How much will the man probably pay?

why.vi: Hôm nay là thứ Ba, cần đến vào thứ Năm nên Priority (2 ngày) là đủ, giá 18 đô.
why.en: He needs delivery in two days, so Priority at $18.

questions.trap: Express nhanh hơn nhưng không cần thiết; Standard quá chậm.

questions.q: What must the man do by four o’clock?

why.vi: Phải đặt dịch vụ trước 4 giờ chiều nay để hôm sau được lấy hàng.
why.en: He must book before four so the package is collected tomorrow.

questions.trap: Nhân viên giao nhận mới là người đến lấy hàng sáng mai.

audio.text: Greg, did you see this week's attendance numbers for our workshops?
I did. The Tuesday one was popular, but the Thursday workshop only had twelve people.
That's down from last month. Maybe we should drop it.
Before we do, let's see how many signed up for each topic. Look at the chart. The accounting class always fills up.
True. And the one on presentation skills is almost as large. Honestly, I'd keep that one too.
Then let's cancel the lowest of the four and use the room for something else.
Agreed. I'll email the participants this afternoon.

why.vi: Họ cân nhắc hủy hội thảo nào do ít người tham dự.
why.en: They decide which class to cancel.

questions.trap: Room chỉ là nơi sẽ dùng cho việc khác.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which workshop will be cancelled?

why.vi: Họ hủy lớp có ít người đăng ký nhất, đó là Time Management với 12 người.
why.en: The lowest enrollment is Time Management at 12.

questions.trap: Excel Tips đông hơn; kế toán và thuyết trình đều được giữ.

questions.q: What will the woman do this afternoon?

why.vi: Cô sẽ gửi email cho người tham dự.
